title: Reactor: magnetic core

hazard.text: Plasma touched the wall: heat spike

guide.mistake: Plasma or ring touches the wall: a heat spike

knobs._note: repair-minigames 1a: the core's load wanders faster and pushes harder each level; both holds grow a second a level; the ring's pull out of round is stronger and quicker.

_min_round_note: Provisional (design 8): 40% of the scripted hand's fastest round at each level, over every state and four seeds, until people's play is measured.
